$why: The writer's half of the detective's 'shared' finding (see detective-shared-package). A developer
changing a shared package and a consumer at once builds and tests the consumer against the
package's working copy, and saves none of that redirection: it is how they test, not what they
ship. The location is RELATIVE to this codeline (operator, 2026-10-01: no absolute paths in a
prompt). Rendered by the fix-plan producer only when a site of this story carries 'shared'.
description: Appended to a writer's fix plan when the detective reported a shared fix site: what is shared, where each sibling codeline's working copy is, and how to build and test against it without saving the redirection.
body:
SHARED WITH OTHER CODELINES OF THIS STORY — the investigation found these fix sites are shared:
__SHARED_SITES__
The other codelines' working copies, relative to this codeline's root:
__SIBLING_LOCATIONS__
Where this codeline consumes a package another codeline provides, that codeline's current working copy (with this run's changes in it) is already installed in this codeline's dependencies by the pipeline, without being saved to the manifest: build and test as they are, and do not change how the dependency resolves. Where a consumer's declared range does not take the version the change ships in, the manifest entry is part of this codeline's change and must be edited. Where this codeline provides the package, its change is not finished until each consumer above can build against it; say in your final message what each consumer needs.
